Prepare enrichment data and default mappings for the dot plot module

Source: R/enrichmentDotPlot_helpers.R
INTERNAL_prepare_enrichment.Rd

Augments an enrichment results table with a numeric GeneRatio column and a neg_log10_pvalue column, guarantees a categorical grouping column for the x-axis, and returns sensible default UI mappings for plotthis::DotPlot().

Usage

.prepare_enrichment(data)

Arguments

data

A data frame of enrichment results.

Value

A list with elements data (the augmented data frame) and mapping (a named list with x, y, size, and fill column names, and size.scale.min: 0 when the size column is a ratio or count that cannot be negative, so dot area is proportional to it, else NULL).

Jacob Martin
